page.overview:
Who is Bakkar?

Bakkar, nicknamed "the Butcher," was a human who owned the restaurant Ronto Roasters in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. A big fan of podracing, Bakkar originally hailed from the planet Tatooine and came from a family that worked as butchers for four generations. Bakkar opened his restaurant with the goal of bringing his famous ronto meat to new customers after moving to Batuu with his droid, 8D-J8.

Bakkar had an unusual way of grilling his meats, utilizing a podracer engine that he purchased and modified. In 34 ABY, 8D-J8's reprogramming that was intended to make the droid man the grill had the side effect of him talking too much; in order to solve the issue, Bakkar contacted the Utai Mubo—8D-J8's original programmer—who eventually agreed to help fix the droid.

Bakkar was a fourth-generation butcher who grew up on the planet Tatooine, where his family's specialty was the ronto creature. He was a big fan of the podracing sport even after it was outlawed across the galaxy. He sold different kinds of specialty meats, but like his family, he was largely known for ronto. He left Tatooine when he came of age, dreaming of selling his family's famous meat on another Outer Rim Territories planet. Once he had earned enough credits, he bought a smelter droid, 8D-J8, who was later designated as a pitmaster droid. 8D-J8 never left his side.

Bakkar traveled to the Outer Rim planet Batuu, where he bought a podracing engine from Savi & Son Salvage at a fair price that he could use to cook his meats. With his ronto recipe ready to go, he opened a restaurant called Ronto Roasters in the Black Spire Outpost settlement in order to bring the ronto to new customers. Bakkar built a large, elaborate mechanical grill, with 8D-J8 serving as the pitmaster of the restaurant, as Bakkar had had the Utai droid scrapper Mubo reprogram him so that his sole duty was to turn the spit, making sure that the meat was cooked evenly and well.
